item.title: HTA Sacks Admin Assistant, Reports Massive Housemen Scam To Police
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Tunku Azizah Hospital says it has sacked an admin assistant, a MyStep staff who allegedly scammed about 190 housemen out of over RM47,000, and filed a police report, stressing that collection of cash or payments to staff's personal accounts isn't allowed. item.title: Restore 300L Monthly Fuel Subsidy Quota For Health Workers — MMA
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: Take Action Against Sale Of Non-Registered, Suspected Counterfeit Blood Pressure Monitors — MPS
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MPS notes reports indicating that non-registered or suspected counterfeit BPMs remain widely accessible. Based on a chain pharmacy's internal screening work last year, 10,081 devices were checked for accuracy; 31% were found to be not registered with MDA.
